exercises.instruction: How do you say these numbers in English? Write your answers after each one.
There are four basic processes in arithmetic. The first one has been given, but what are the other three?

Using only the numbers and symbols in the box, write out the calculations which produce the answers for each number below. There may be more than one way of calculating an answer, but you only need to provide one correct answer in each case.
Fill the gaps in these sentences, one word for each gap.
items: 1 One, three and five are .............................. numbers; two, four and six are .............................. numbers.
3 If a test has 30 marks and you got 21, you could say this as twenty-one .............................. .............................. thirty.
